# MDDL (Market Data Definition Language) 3.0-beta

The last full specification release of MDDL, an XML-based market data
description language originally developed by the Financial Information
Services Division (FISD) of the Software & Information Industry Association
(SIIA). See `manifest.json` for per-file provenance (source URL, sha256,
size) and `methodology.txt` for how these files were located and downloaded.

The original mddl.org site is defunct; these files were retrieved from the
Internet Archive's Wayback Machine capture of mddl.org's downloads page
(2014-04-07 snapshot).

## Contents

- `mddl-3.0-beta-full.xsd` — the full XML Schema (all asset domains).
- `mddl-3.0-beta-lite.xsd` — a reduced-scope variant of the schema.
- `mddl-3.0-beta-link.xsd` — linking/reference schema fragment.
- `mddl-3.0-beta-technical-specification.pdf` — the narrative technical spec.
- `mddl-license.pdf` — MDDL's own license terms as published by FISD/SIIA.
- `mddl-3.0-beta.txt` — index of every file in the full 3.0-beta release zip.
- `mddl-3.0-beta-changes.txt` — changelog vs. the prior 2.0-beta release.
- `mddl-equity-example1.xml` — a worked example instance document (EOD equity snap for Lafarge SA).

## Knowledge doc

See `doc/knowledge/domain/market_data_definition_language.org`
(id `0FF6A2DC-EE01-4C3C-AF86-A0D08FD93925`) for what MDDL is, its version
history, and how it compares to ORE Studio's own identifier schemes.
